title: get from system
rule: Get information from the system whenever possible; do not ask people to type data you can gather automatically or with permission.
pass_when: Data the system can gather (auto or with permission) is gathered, not typed.
fail_when: User types data the system already has or can request.
overview: Gather data from the system automatically or with permission, not by retyping.
apply_when: Values the OS, device, or account can supply with or without permission.
not_when: Data the system cannot obtain and the user must provide.
agent_hint: Pull system-available data automatically or with permission; do not re-ask.
description: Get information from the system whenever possible; do not ask people to type data you can gather automatically or with permission. Pass when such data is gathered rather than typed; fail when the user types what the system already has or can request. Prefer permissioned capture over manual re-entry of known values from device, OS, or account sources.
